page.layout: One page of text; decorative woodcut frieze at top; title in large type centred; body in one column with a historiated woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph; no margin notes; no running head or page number printed.

main_text.head: SPECTATAE TVM PIETATIS, TVM DOCTRI- NAE VIRO, D. IOANNI IOHN- STONO amico summè observando.

p.i: Eriùs ad tuas literas, vt ferò mihi redditas, respondeo, mi Iohnstone, ex quibus pergratum mihi fuit intelligere te salvum ad tuos reversum, Ecclesias vestras in beato & tranquillo statu comperisse, quem illis perpetuum & securum in longos annos exopto. Et quidni sic futurum confidam? Quum & tàm praclarè iam inde ab initio fuerint à magnis illis & verè fidis servis Dei iacta earum fundamenta: & qui supervenerunt, non stipulas, neque fœnum; sed aurum & argentum, & lapides verè pretiosos superstruxerint: immò sanctis eorum laboribus sic Deus manifestè faverit, ut quicunque ad hoc Dei ædificium impegerunt, non modò suis conatibus excciderint; verùm etiam procul,

page.notes: The woodcut initial "E" is decorative and was transcribed as the letter E. The title line "SPECTATAE TVM" is set in italic capitals with the Æ ligature as printed. Possible misprint: "impegerunt" and "excciderint" transcribed as printed. The first word of the title is partly ornamented; reading of "SPECTATAE" is secure.
